reviewed_by: Codex SSH host metadata workflow review
reason: SSH comments directly below a concrete Host line now remain optional discovery metadata and are added to each selected host's model-visible tool description without mutating saved operator notes. Thirty-one focused Python cases cover SSH discovery, selection, optional metadata enrichment, tool descriptions, approval, execution, timeout, cancellation, API persistence, and failure handling. Ten component cases cover the changed environment settings guidance and existing host lifecycle. Eight catalogued real-Core browser cases exercise discovery, enable, probe, metadata display, save, reload, accessibility, touch geometry, and responsive layout in the permanent desktop and emulated mobile Chromium/WebKit matrix.
exclusions: No full suites, unrelated chat, harness, MCP, packaging, or native tests. The catalogued real-Core SSH environment journey already uses the production bundle on a non-loopback LAN origin. The uncatalogued generic real-core duplicate is excluded. Physical-device coverage is unavailable and is not inferred from emulation.
